## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues where applicable.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results, including any skipped checks and why.
The full project check is `make check`.

## Configuration and installation impact

Describe any required configuration changes or deployment steps.
If installation changes, explain how existing configuration and runtime data are preserved.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and has a clear description.
- [ ] Behavioral fixes include a regression test.
- [ ] Relevant documentation, examples and changelog entries are updated.
- [ ] I ran `make check` or explained skipped checks above.
- [ ] No private override YAML, `.creds`, deployment configuration, secrets or runtime data are included.
